In [[3640 BBY]], the [[Dark Council]]lor [[Darth Marr]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] made use of a '''stronghold''' as personal estate. Located outside [[Kaas City]] in the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the stronghold possessed a private [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]] and its walls were busy with household servants and [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] personnel.
